glossary_definitions.skill_deferred_choice: Skip a card reward to save 1 offered card; it replaces 1 card in your next non-boss card reward.

relic_descriptions.witchglass_lantern: Your @icon(illusion) shed @icon(illuminate) {radius} tiles farther while they last.
relic_descriptions.winters_spur: Moving across @term(surface_ice) without turning costs only 1 @kw(movement). Turning starts a new stretch.
relic_descriptions.galehook_talon: Your @kw(push) and @kw(pull) move the target together with every enemy connected to it by contact along that direction. Only the front one collides.

skill_descriptions.witchlight: Your @icon(illusion) shed @icon(illuminate) 1 tile farther while they last.

erupt_tooltip:
Erupt
Emerges at its mark, or the nearest free tile.
